intro.fr: Marble It Up! Ultra se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Marble It Up! Ultra can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub KitLemonfoot/ArchipelagoMIUU, qui héberge l'APWorld de Marble It Up! Ultra.
text.en: The GitHub repository KitLemonfoot/ArchipelagoMIUU, home of the Marble It Up! Ultra APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0-alpha.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0-alpha, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.3.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (6 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.3.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (6 versions released).

text.fr: Marble It Up! Ultra figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Marble It Up! Ultra is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
